sonic.cheatsLead: Level select is a title-screen code on many dumps: ↑ ↓ ← → hold A, Start. RAM codes are in the list too.
sonic.s1b: Build speed on the slope, keep rings, hit the end sign. Shields help before the boss.
sonic.s2b: Lava is the usual death. Walk, do not charge into fireballs. Save a state on act 3.
sonic.s3b: Labyrinth drowning: hit air bubbles. Level select skips it if you only want Scrap Brain.
sonic.s4b: Speed is safe here. Jump the bombs, do not lose all rings before the boss.
sonic.s5b: Robotnik patterns are short. Hit him, dodge, repeat. Invincible cheat is optional.
sonic.a1: Lives, rings, invincible, plus the title-screen level select on many Genesis dumps.
sonic.a2: Yes. Mega Drive is mid-weight. Landscape plus a pad is best.
sonic.q4: How do I open level select?
sonic.a4: On many US titles: Up Down Left Right, hold A, press Start. Some revisions differ.
sonic.a5: Different ROM. This page is Sonic 1. Same emulator core.

streets-of-rage-2.lead: Streets of Rage 2 is the Mega Drive beat-em-up with Blaze, Axel, Max, and Skate. Play in this tab.
streets-of-rage-2.cheatsLead: Same-character is a title-screen hold. RAM lives/special codes go in the cheat menu.
streets-of-rage-2.s1b: Blaze is faster; Max hits hard and is slower. Skate is good on a pad, harder on touch.
streets-of-rage-2.s2b: Specials cost health. Use them when surrounded, not on every grunt.
streets-of-rage-2.s3b: Grab, throw, keep moving right. Eat, do not skip food if your bar is yellow.
streets-of-rage-2.s4b: Clear the wave before you chase the next spawn. Two-player can trap you at the edge.
streets-of-rage-2.s5b: Save a state. Specials for the last phase. Lives cheats if you only want the credits.
streets-of-rage-2.a1: Lives, specials, stage, and the same-character title trick are listed.
streets-of-rage-2.a2: Yes. A Bluetooth pad helps more than for Sonic.
streets-of-rage-2.a3: No. Load a Mega Drive dump.
streets-of-rage-2.a4: On many dumps, hold B and press Start on the portrait. Revisions differ.
streets-of-rage-2.a5: Throw, eat, special only in crowds. Steps above continue through Mr. X.

alter-ego.description: Play Alter Ego, a freeware NES puzzle by Shiru, in this tab. Swap with your alter ego, collect pixels. ROM hosted with permission of the author's freeware license.
alter-ego.lead: Alter Ego is a 2011 NES homebrew port of a ZX Spectrum puzzle. Swap places with your ghost twin to reach every bouncing pixel.
alter-ego.cheatsLead: No Game Genie pack. The puzzle is short; save states are enough if a room is unclear.
alter-ego.s1b: The freeware ROM is hosted on cv.cm S3. Press play; you do not need to choose a file.
alter-ego.s2b: The twin mirrors you. Use the swap button to trade places and cross gaps the living body cannot.
alter-ego.s3b: Collect every bouncing pixel in the room to open the exit. Do not stand under them if a jump is tight.
alter-ego.s4b: Think before you swap. You can trap both bodies. Reset the room from the emulator menu if needed.
alter-ego.s5b: Freeware from Shiru. Not a Nintendo title. If you like it, look up Shiru's other NES homebrew.
alter-ego.q1: Is Alter Ego free to play here?
alter-ego.a1: Yes. It is freeware NES homebrew. The ROM is on our S3, not a commercial dump.
alter-ego.a2: Shiru, 2011, based on Denis Grachev's Spectrum game. Source and manual shipped with the original zip.
alter-ego.a3: None bundled. Use emulator save states.
alter-ego.a4: Yes. Small ROM, NES core, virtual pad.
alter-ego.a5: So you can try the emulator immediately with a legal ROM while classic pages ask you to load your own file.

lawn-mower.cheatsLead: No cheat pack. Restart a stage from the emulator if you block yourself.
lawn-mower.s1b: The ROM loads from S3. Start in the emulator; no file picker needed.
lawn-mower.s2b: Drive over every grass tile. Plan a path that does not trap you in a corner.
lawn-mower.s3b: Mowed tiles may not be a path back. Think like a snake.
lawn-mower.s5b: Freeware by Shiru. Not a commercial Nintendo game.
lawn-mower.q1: Is Lawn Mower legal to host?
lawn-mower.a1: Yes. Shiru released it as NES freeware. We keep the ROM on S3 next to the EmulatorJS cores.
lawn-mower.a2: None. Restart the stage if you trap the mower.
lawn-mower.q5: Can I load my own NES ROM here too?
